ORDER BY id\",\n            (session_id,),\n        ).fetchall()\n        for r in rows:\n            conditions.setdefault(r[\"target\"], []).append(\n                {\"condition\": r[\"condition\"], \"remaining_rounds\": r[\"remaining_rounds\"]}\n            )\n\n        return {\n            \"id\": session_id,\n            \"round\": round_num,\n            \"turn_index\": turn_index,\n            \"active\": {\"name\": active[\"name\"], \"score\": active[\"score\"]},\n            \"conditions\": conditions,\n        }\n\n\n# --- Compendium ---\n\n\ndef create_monster(slug, name, cr, armor_class, hit_points, tags):\n    \"\"\"Create a monster entry; Junction tables enforce\n  composite keys.\n- Foreign keys are declared in the DDL but are not enabled at runtime; the\n  application enforces referential integrity through the storage layer.\n\n### Request routing\n\nRoutes live in a single Flask Blueprint (`api`) that is registered in `app.py`.\nThe Blueprint is populated by importing the `routes/` submodules, so the URL map\nis the union of all registered endpoints. The route layer does three things:\n\n1. Parse and validate the JSON body.\n2. Call the appropriate domain function, service, or storage function.\n3. Return the same JSON body and status code as the previous checkpoint.\n\nRoutes do not contain SQL or business math beyond input validation. Returns the new turn state,\n    None if the encounter is missing, or False if it has no combatants.\n    \"\"\"\n    with _get_db() as conn:\n        if conn.execute(\n            \"SELECT 1 FROM play_encounters WHERE campaign_id = ? AND encounter_id = ?\",\n            (camp_id, enc_id),\n        ).fetchone() is None:\n            return None\n        combatants = _encounter_combatants(conn, camp_id, enc_id)\n        if not combatants:\n            return False\n        row = conn.execute(\n            \"SELECT round, turn_index FROM play_encounters WHERE campaign_id = ? AND encounter_id = ?\",\n            (camp_id, enc_id),\n        ).fetchone()\n        turn_index = row[\"turn_index\"] % len(combatants)\n        next_index = turn_index + 1\n        round_num = row[\"round\"]\n        if next_index >= len(combatants):\n            next_index = 0\n            round_num += 1\n        active = combatants[next_index]\n\n        # Decay and remove expired conditions at the start of the active turn.\n        conn.execute(\n            \"UPDATE play_encounter_conditions SET remaining_rounds = remaining_rounds - 1 \"\n            \"WHERE campaign_id = ? AND character_id = ?\",\n            (camp_id, recipient_character_id),\n        ).fetchone() is None:\n            return \"invalid_recipient\"\n        # Check voter already voted\n        if conn.execute(\n            \"SELECT 1 FROM play_loot_votes WHERE campaign_id = ? AND loot_id = ? AND recipient_character_id = ?\",\n            (camp_id, loot_id, recipient_character_id),\n        ).fetchone()\n    return {\n        \"loot_id\": loot_id,\n        \"voter\": voter,\n        \"recipient_character_id\": recipient_character_id,\n        \"votes_for_recipient\": count_row[\"cnt\"],\n    }\n```\n\n```python\ndef assign_loot(camp_id, loot_id):\n    with _get_db() as conn:\n        loot_row = conn.execute(\n            \"SELECT item_id, quantity, status FROM play_loot WHERE campaign_id = ? AND loot_id = ?\",\n            (camp_id, loot_id),\n        ).fetchone()\n        if loot_row is None:\n            return None\n        if loot_row[\"status\"] != \"open\":\n            return \"not_open\"\n        \n        # Count votes per recipient\n        rows = conn.execute(\n            \"SELECT recipient_character_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM play_loot_votes \"\n            \"WHERE campaign_id = ? WHERE campaign_id = ? AND loot_id = ?\",\n            (\"assigned\", winner, camp_id, loot_id),\n        )\n        conn.commit()\n    return {\n        \"loot_id\": loot_id,\n        \"recipient_character_id\": winner,\n        \"item_id\": loot_row[\"item_id\"],\n        \"quantity\": loot_row[\"quantity\"],\n        \"votes\": max_count,\n        \"status\": \"assigned\",\n    }\n```\n\n```python\ndef get_loot(camp_id, loot_id):\n    with _get_db() as conn:\n        row = conn.execute(\n            \"SELECT loot_id, item_id, quantity, status, recipient_character_id FROM play_loot \"\n            \"WHERE campaign_id = ? AND loot_id = ?\",\n            (camp_id, loot_id),\n        ).fetchone()\n        if row is None:\n            return None\n        vote_rows = conn.execute(\n            \"SELECT voter, recipient_character_id FROM play_loot_votes \"\n            \"WHERE campaign_id = ?
